description: Create eBay DRAFT offers for up to 25 products — real writes to the seller's eBay account, but nothing is buyer-visible until publish_ebay_drafts. Run inspect_ebay_listings first and pass only products whose nextAction is create_draft and ready is true. Each product is attempted on its own: returns created, failed (each with a reason to look up in remediation.ebayPlaybook) and notAttempted (not reached in the time budget — call again with those ids). Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing, and while draft creation is not armed on the eBay connection. Not idempotent: a product that already has a draft fails with alreadyListed. The result echoes the workspace.

marketplaceId.description: Omit this when the eBay connection sells on exactly one marketplace — the server fills it in automatically. Pass one of the audit's armed ebayDraftSetup.marketplaceIds only when several marketplaces are armed. This is a MARKETPLACE id (e.g. EBAY_DE, EBAY_IT) — never the eBay CONNECTION/adapter id.

productIds.description: The exact products to create eBay draft offers for, at most 25 ids fetched with search_products. This creates drafts only and never makes them live.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.

name: create_ebay_drafts
title: Create eBay drafts
